notes.title: Steam Achievements!
notes.content:
From now on, [i][b]El Virus[/b][/i] achievements are active. Will you be able to obtain all of them?

Additionally, there has been an addition of an advisory message to the previous animation regarding levels. These inform the player that a click must be made to continue.

Finally, an error that occurred when the player approached the class kids has been fixed.

Therefore:

[u][b]Added[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Advise of "Click to continue"
[/list]

[u][b]Fixed[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Class kids rotated when getting close to them
[/list]

tags.bug: Class kids rotated when getting close to them

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
- The options menus have been fixed.

- Bugs that were present during death and restarting without quitting the game have been fixed.

- A skip option has been added to level introductions, making it easier and faster to re-game it.
